title: Austin's New Mayor & Council Elected
summary:
*   The city officially confirmed the results of the General Municipal Run-Off Election held on April 30, 1977.
*   Carole Keeton McClellan was declared Austin's new Mayor, securing the win over Jack McCreary.
*   Lee Cooke, Ron Mullen, and Richard Goodman were announced as the newly elected City Council members for Places 1, 3, and 4, respectively.
